meta.title: AI Email MCP Server Pricing: Free, Personal, Pro and Team Plans
meta.description: Free connects one inbox. Personal connects three for $5 a month. Pro connects every mailbox your business runs for $15. Team adds members, roles and SSO.

items.q: What do I get on the free plan?
items.a: One connected inbox, forever, with no card, and 150 email actions a calendar month. Your first 7 days after signup are not counted, so you can wire up your agent and try everything before the meter starts. Your agent gets every MCP tool we ship against that mailbox: read, search, organise, label, draft, schedule and send, plus the per-inbox send review and approval hold. When you want a second or third mailbox, or no monthly cap on actions, that is Personal, at $5 a month.

items.q: What does Personal add over Free?
items.a: Two more connected inboxes, no monthly cap on email actions (fair use applies), double the burst ceiling (120 requests a minute instead of 60), and email support instead of the community forum. That is the whole list. Everything else is already on Free: every MCP tool including scheduled sends, the per-inbox send review and approval hold, and the usage analytics dashboard. We do not hold features back from Free to make the paid tiers look bigger.

items.q: What counts as an email action?
items.a: One tool call against your /mcp endpoint that touches a mailbox: a read, a search, a move, a draft, a send. Listing your inboxes (inbox_list) and anything you do in the dashboard are never counted. We're a standard MCP server, so the same endpoint works with Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Windsurf, n8n, Make, and any MCP-compatible client. Free includes 150 email actions a calendar month; Personal, Pro and Team have no monthly cap, subject to fair use.

items.q: What happens when I reach 150 email actions?
items.a: Every other email action in that workspace is refused until the 1st of the next month (UTC), when the allowance resets. Your agent sees a plain tool result saying how many actions were used and when the counter resets, so it knows retrying will not help. Unattended automations pause and resume by themselves on the 1st. The dashboard and inbox_list keep working, and we email you at 80% and again at 100%. Personal removes the monthly cap for $5 a month. Workspaces created before 2026-09-12 are early members and are not metered against the allowance.

items.q: Is my email content stored anywhere?
items.a: The email your agent reads is never stored: bodies, subjects, attachments, and thread content are fetched live from your provider and returned directly to the agent, with nothing persisted between calls. We store your encrypted OAuth token or app password so we can authenticate future requests. The one exception is a message you ask us to schedule for later. We store it until it is sent, and keep a record afterwards for your history.

items.q: What's the difference between Personal, Pro and Team?
items.a: Personal is one seat with three connected inboxes, a 120 requests/minute ceiling, and email support. Pro is still one seat and one login, with no inbox limit at all, so one person can connect every mailbox a company runs (sales, invoices, support, info). It also has a 300 requests/minute ceiling, 90 days of analytics history instead of 30, and email support. Team is for when more than one person needs to sign in: unlimited members with roles, a separate workspace per client or business, SSO (SAML / OIDC), an audit log, a year of analytics history, and priority support.

items.q: What if I need a fourth inbox?
items.a: Personal covers three connected inboxes. A fourth moves you to Pro at $15 a month, and that lifts the limit entirely: every mailbox you or your company runs, however many, on one agent and one login. If you are sitting just over three and that does not work for you, tell us at hello@mcpemails.com.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my plan?
items.a: Yes. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel any time from the billing section of your dashboard. Cancelling stops the next renewal and you keep everything you paid for until the end of the current period, then drop to Free with one connected inbox. We don't refund partial periods, but see the refund question below for the first charge on a new subscription.

items.q: How does the annual discount work?
items.a: Paying annually saves about 20% versus monthly: Personal is $48 a year ($4 a month), Pro is $144 a year ($12 a month) and Team is $756 a year ($63 a month). You're charged once for 12 months upfront. Cancelling stops the renewal and you keep access until the year you paid for ends. Apart from the 14-day refund on a first charge, we don't refund the remaining months.

Gmail connects with an app password by default, or by signing in with Google (OAuth). Outlook and Microsoft 365 connect by signing in with Microsoft (OAuth): personal accounts connect directly, and a work or school account may need its IT admin to approve the app once. Fastmail connects with an app password. iCloud, Yahoo, Zoho, and Yandex connect with an app-specific password, and any other mailbox works through the generic IMAP / SMTP connector.

Yes. If the first charge on a new subscription isn't what you expected, email us within 14 days and we refund it in full. After that, you can cancel any time and keep access until the end of the period you've already paid for, but we don't refund partial periods. If you're a consumer in the EU or the UK, those same 14 days are your statutory right of withdrawal.

items.q: Can I self-host it instead of paying?
items.a: Yes. MCP Emails is open source under AGPL-3.0 and free to self-host. A docker-compose stack runs the same MCP server, with your mailbox credentials encrypted under a key only you hold. Self-host covers IMAP and SMTP mailboxes. Gmail and Outlook sign-in (OAuth) and the dashboard stay on the hosted service, where they work on every plan, Free included; team features and email support are on the paid plans.
